name: cavemio-kanban-board
title: Kanban board
description: A pipeline you rearrange by hand: the card becomes the stage it's over while still in the air, and every column's total rolls as it passes.

cavemio.accessibility:
- Each column is a labelled section with an ordered list; each card says its name, column, place and amount. Space or Enter picks a card up, arrows carry it (up and down in its column, left and right across columns, skipping none: a column that refuses says why), Space drops it and Escape puts it back. Every step is announced, and onMove runs once, on the drop.
- While a card is carried the board writes transforms only: the card's own (with its tilt) and the shift of the cards making way. React re-renders only when the column or slot under it changes, for the chip and the totals. On the drop every card is snapshotted where it is on screen, the new order is laid out, and each glides from its snapshot.
- On touch, the board scrolls as usual; a 300ms hold picks a card up and only then does the page stop scrolling under the finger. Near the board's sides it scrolls sideways, near the window's edges the page scrolls. Narrow, columns snap one at a time.
- Reduced motion moves cards in place, without tilt, glides or shakes; chips, totals, amber refusals and the announcements still say what happened.
cavemio.previewNote: Interactive local fixture. Data and async results are simulated in the preview; the caller supplies application services.

props.name: columns
props.description: – · { id, title, tone?, limit?, done? }. tone picks one of the five chart colours for its chip; limit caps it; done draws a check on its chip.

props.name: cards / defaultCards
props.description: – · The cards, in the order they stand in their columns.

props.name: onCardsChange
props.description: – · The new order after every move, add and failed-save revert.

props.name: renderCard
props.description: – · The card's own content. The board adds the status chip (the column it's over while carried) and the value under it.

props.name: cardLabel
props.description: – · How a card is named in its accessible name and announcements.

props.name: refuse
props.description: – · A reason a column won't take a card; the column says it while the card is over it. Limits are checked for you.

props.name: onMove
props.description: – · Saves a move (the card already has its new column). Throw to fly it back.

props.name: value
props.description: – · An amount per card, shown on it and totalled (rolling) in each column head.

props.name: valueFormat / locales
props.description: – · How amounts are written, e.g. { style: "currency", currency: "USD" }.

props.name: onAdd
props.description: – · Shows "+ Add …" at the foot of each column; return the new card.

props.name: addLabel
props.description: "card" · The noun in "+ Add …" and the new card's field.

features.title: Carry the real card
features.description: It follows you exactly and tilts a little with how fast you move it, then settles upright.

features.title: Columns make room
features.description: The column under the card opens a gap at the exact slot, and the counts and totals roll as the card passes.

features.title: The card shows its next stage
features.description: While still in the air, the card’s status chip turns into the stage it is over. A finishing column draws a check.

features.title: Rules and limits
features.description: A column at its limit, or one whose rule the card breaks, turns amber and says why. Let go and the card springs home.

features.title: It saves, or flies back
features.description: onMove saves each drop. If it fails, the card flies back with a shake and its column says it couldn’t move.

features.title: Add cards, move by keyboard
features.description: “+ Add deal” grows into a field. Space and the arrow keys carry a card, announced step by step, and touch uses a short hold.

states.title: pick up
states.description: After 4px (or a 300ms hold on touch, with a short vibration where supported) the card lifts: 1.03 scale, a darker thin line, above everything. It follows the pointer one to one and tilts up to 5° with its sideways speed, eased by one frame loop that runs only while it's carried.

states.title: gaps
states.description: The column under the card opens a gap at the slot its centre is over (240ms, transforms only) and grows by a card; the column it left closes up behind it. Same column: the cards between the old and new slot make way.

states.title: becomes
states.description: Over another column the card's chip takes that column's name (TextMorph) and colour (300ms), and a done column draws a check; the column's border and ground take its tint. Counts and totals roll in both columns as if it had already moved.

states.title: refuse
states.description: A column at its limit, or whose refuse() returns a reason, turns amber, gives a short shake, says why under its title and opens no gap. Let go there and the card springs home (460ms, slight overshoot); the reason stays 3.2s.

states.title: drop
states.description: Everything on the board glides from where it is on screen to its new place; the carried card unwinds its tilt and lands with a slight overshoot. If onMove throws, it flies back the same way, shakes, and its column says it couldn't move.

states.title: add
states.description: "+ Add deal" fades as a ring and ground grow into a card-sized field by grid rows (380ms). Enter adds what onAdd returns; Escape or an empty field folds it back.

states.title: collapse
states.description: A column folds to a 48px strip with its count and a vertical title (width 420ms). It still takes a carried card, at its end.
